needs.label: Just listen
needs.hint: Hear me without trying to fix it.

needs.label: A little affection
needs.hint: A hug, a kind word, a little closeness.

needs.label: Quiet space
needs.hint: A little room to recharge, still loved.

needs.label: Practical help
needs.hint: Take one small thing off my plate.

needs.label: Time together
needs.hint: A few unhurried minutes, just us.

needs.label: Reassurance
needs.hint: Remind me we are on the same team.

appreciations.label: I admire
appreciations.starter: Something I admire about you is…

appreciations.label: Just because
appreciations.starter: A tiny reason I’m glad it’s you…

starterPacks.title: Everyday us
starterPacks.subtitle: Find the lovely in your ordinary.
questions: Which unplanned minute from a recent outing do you remember better than the thing we went there to do?
When we are doing separate things in the same room, what makes it feel like time together?
Which part of my daily routine do you understand least from the outside?
What keeps interrupting time we meant to enjoy together, and what would an easy workaround look like?
Which ordinary evening would you like to replay with one detail changed?
On a morning when we wake up in different moods, what would a good first hour look like for each of us?
What did I quietly take care of recently that you only noticed afterward?
If we improved one ordinary evening instead of planning a big date, what would you move, add, or skip?

starterPacks.title: A little more understood
starterPacks.subtitle: Make room for each other’s inner world.
questions: Which current decision has more than one good option, and what makes choosing difficult?
When you are quiet, how can I tell the difference between wanting company and wanting to be left alone?
Think of a day that ran longer than expected: which offer of help would have landed well, and which would have added work?
Which part of something you care about gets flattened when you try to explain it quickly?
Which small disagreement have we handled in a way you would want us to repeat?
Which interest of yours would be easier to show me than explain, and what would we start with?
When a plan is uncertain, do you prefer more options, one next step, or some time before deciding?
What is a view you held a year ago that you would phrase differently now?

starterPacks.title: Love in the little things
starterPacks.subtitle: Notice what already makes you, you.
questions: When have I made room for your preference even though it was not mine?
What is something I do before you ask that makes a specific part of your day work better?
Which detail from a very ordinary day with me would be hardest to explain to someone who was not there?
Which difference between us has become something you would miss if it disappeared?
When did you see me do something in my own way and think, 'that is very them'?
On a low-energy day, which kind of affection feels easy to receive and which takes effort?
Which compliment would mean more because it names effort rather than talent?
What have we gotten better at together that nobody else would think to congratulate us for?

starterPacks.title: Dreaming in the same direction
starterPacks.subtitle: Little hopes. A future with room for both.
questions: Which thing we keep calling 'someday' would still excite you if we tried a small version this month?
If our future routines became busier, which ordinary shared habit would you protect first?
What would you want to learn about a place before agreeing to live there for a year?
Which part of our future would you like to keep flexible rather than map out now?
What could we repeat each year that would still work if our budget, location, or energy changed?
Which personal goal would benefit from me asking about the process instead of the result?
What about our current circumstances do you think future us might be surprised we managed?
Which future decision needs more real-world information before we form a strong opinion about it?

starterPacks.title: A little ridiculous
starterPacks.subtitle: Less overthinking. More giggling.
questions: Our terrarium resident writes one complaint about our decorating: what is it, and what change would settle it?
We have to run a two-person business using only skills we already have: who does what, and what goes wrong first?
Which everyday object would you nominate for a ridiculously specific world championship, and what are the rules?
If one of our harmless habits became a spectator sport, what would the commentator keep saying?
We can give our resident one completely impractical room: what is in it, and what does it never get used for?
We swap daily routines for a day: which moment would make each of us call for backup?
Which of our inside jokes would become most confusing if someone tried to explain it professionally?
A board game based on an ordinary day with us needs one unfairly powerful bonus card: what does it do?

starterPacks.title: Back on the same team
starterPacks.subtitle: Gentle conversations, when you both feel ready.
questions: In a recent small disagreement, what were we each trying to protect that may have sounded like something else?
How would you like a pause to end so it does not feel as though a difficult conversation has been abandoned?
When I get something wrong, which detail helps you tell a misunderstanding from not being taken seriously?
What is a sentence I could say that would show I understood your point before explaining mine?
Which repeated minor friction would be easier to solve by changing the setup rather than asking either of us to try harder?
After an apology, which small follow-through makes the words feel believable to you?
What is something you would like to be able to decline without having to defend the reason?
Which agreement should we make smaller so we can realistically keep it on a difficult week?

rituals.title: Our soft landing
rituals.description: Set the week down. Pick up each other.

prompts.label: A little light
prompts.question: Which moment from this week would you have wanted me to see?

prompts.label: Something to hold gently
prompts.question: Which part of the week needed more energy than it looked like from the outside?

prompts.label: Something I noticed
prompts.question: Which effort did your partner make this week that you might normally leave unmentioned?

prompts.label: A little room for next week
prompts.question: Which single change would make our actual plans for next week work better for both people?

rituals.title: A little exhale
rituals.description: For a full week and a softer evening.

prompts.label: Leave it here
prompts.question: Which unfinished thought can we acknowledge without trying to fix it tonight?

prompts.label: A little care
prompts.question: What looks like rest from the outside but does not actually help you recharge?

prompts.label: A moment for us
prompts.question: What would genuinely fit the time and energy we have left tonight?

rituals.title: The two-of-us pause
rituals.description: A small date with a little more meaning.

prompts.label: A little closer
prompts.question: Which moment this week made you feel we were paying attention to the same thing?

prompts.label: Still getting to know you
prompts.question: What did you recently start reading, watching, or trying that you want to tell me about?

prompts.label: More of this
prompts.question: Which part of this evening would you like to repeat without turning it into another obligation?

dreamStarters.title: A weekend somewhere new
dreamStarters.text: A place we are curious about, with room for both our travel styles.

dreamStarters.title: Make our space feel like home
dreamStarters.text: Small changes that make everyday life more comfortable.

dreamStarters.title: Learn something side by side
dreamStarters.text: Choose a class, skill, or hobby we can explore at our own pace.

dreamStarters.title: Start a tradition with our friends
dreamStarters.text: An easy reason to spend time with the people we care about.

dreamStarters.title: Make a tiny creative project
dreamStarters.text: Something we can make together, just because we would enjoy it.

dreamStarters.title: Set aside a future fund
dreamStarters.text: A shared hope and a realistic first conversation about getting there.

dreamStarters.title: Grow a real little garden
dreamStarters.text: A windowsill, a pot, or a patch of ground we can care for.

dreamStarters.title: A trip to see someone we miss
dreamStarters.text: Make room for the friends or family who live farther away.

dreamStarters.title: Try an unfamiliar adventure
dreamStarters.text: Something new that suits our energy, budget, and access needs.

dreamStarters.title: Build a gentler everyday rhythm
dreamStarters.text: A life with room for rest, individual interests, and time together.

dreamStarters.title: Make a book of our memories
dreamStarters.text: Collect the ordinary little moments we want to remember.

dreamStarters.title: Support our separate ambitions
dreamStarters.text: A shared plan with space for both people to grow.

prompts.text: What’s one small thing I do that makes you feel loved?
What would make this week feel a little lighter for you?
What ordinary moment with me would you love to relive?
What’s something you wish I understood better about your day?
What’s a little dream you’d like us to make room for?
If our terrarium could have one ridiculous object, what would you choose?
What’s something I did recently that you quietly appreciated?
When you’re overwhelmed, what kind of company helps most?
When did you feel closest to me this week?
What’s a tiny detail from our early days you still remember?
What’s a new tradition you’d like us to start?
What would our little creature say about us as a couple?
What’s a part of yourself you’ve been getting to know lately?
What’s something you’d love a little encouragement with?
What makes you feel at home with me?
What would a really lovely, ordinary day together look like?
What’s one thing we could do more slowly together?
What’s a small adventure you’re glad we shared?
What helps you feel listened to?
Which of us would be the frog, and which would be the snail?
What quality in me have you grown to appreciate more over time?
What does a peaceful evening look like to you right now?
What place would you like us to explore together someday?
Is there a responsibility you’d like us to approach more as a team?
What’s a question you’d like me to ask you more often?
What’s an inside joke that always makes you smile?
What’s a small sign that you need a little extra care?
What’s something about us that you feel proud of?
What would you name a tiny café inside our terrarium?
What’s one little thing you’re looking forward to with me?

landmarks.name: The hollow log
landmarks.hint: Something is rustling under the log.
landmarks.description: A sleepy ladybug has made a home in the soft wood.

landmarks.name: Mushroom grove
landmarks.hint: Three little caps. Try tapping each one.
landmarks.description: The mushrooms answer with a soft glow. You found the grove’s little melody.

landmarks.name: Moonstone cave
landmarks.hint: There is a cool breeze behind the ivy.
landmarks.description: A little cave opens into a quiet underground pool.

landmarks.name: Willow pond
landmarks.hint: Trace a ripple across the water.
landmarks.description: A school of tiny silver fish follows the ripples.

landmarks.name: The seed garden
landmarks.hint: Plant a seed, give it water, and come back in a minute.
landmarks.description: Your first little flower grew in the forest garden.

landmarks.name: Firefly grove
landmarks.hint: Come back at night. Touch the lights gently.
landmarks.description: The fireflies gather around you, then float back into the trees.

landmarks.name: The wishing well
landmarks.hint: Each of you can leave a little light here.
landmarks.description: Two little lights, one shared wish. The well remembers you both.

landmarks.name: Rainy hollow
landmarks.hint: Try a little rain and look closely.
landmarks.description: The shallow hollow fills with water, and a tiny wild frog comes to visit.

landmarks.name: The old oak
landmarks.hint: There is a folded blanket beneath the oak.
landmarks.description: A quiet place to sit, leave a note, and come back to each other.

landmarks.name: Crystal pool
landmarks.hint: A small crystal glimmers deep inside the cave.
landmarks.description: The underground water reflects a whole sky of little crystals.
